content:
Actor-comedian Dane Cook and his wife, fitness instructor Kelsi Taylor, will soon be a family of three.

“We’ve been bursting with excitement to share this news!” she wrote alongside a trio of images that included the couple holding up a sonogram.

Taylor’s caption also included “1 Samuel 1:27,” an allusion to a Bible verse that reads: “For this child I prayed; and the Lord has granted me my petition which I made to him.”

The announcement comes a little more than three years after the couple married in an intimate Hawaii ceremony that included just 20 guests, according to People.

“I’m just excited at the possibility,” he said at the time. “Her sister just had her second baby, and I love seeing her with the kid. She loves it, and I love kids. When the time is right, we’ll check it out.”

As to what type of parent he thought he’d be, he added: “I could see myself hopefully as the kind of dad that loves to listen, loves to be there, loves to collaborate, but still teach you to set those boundaries and only want to pull the best out of yourself.”

Cook, whose credits include the films “Employee of the Month” and “My Best Friend’s Girl,” proposed to Taylor in 2022 after about five years of dating.

The couple’s relationship has drawn a fair amount of public scrutiny, given that Taylor was only 18 when she started dating Cook, who is 27 years her senior.

“We have a bit of an age difference, so it’s in the show,” he quipped to E! News around the time of the special’s release. “If we can’t laugh at it, then nobody else is allowed.”
